title: When Links Mislead: Label-Free Structural Polarity for Zero-Shot Classification of Web Pages
abstract: arXiv:2610.41464v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Web platforms such as digital libraries, online stores and university sites must classify new pages before anyone labels them. Large language models (LLMs) can label each page from its text, but these labels are noisy, and links could correct them only where linked pages share classes. Existing zero-shot methods ignore the links, or pull a page toward its neighbours as label propagation and graph neural networks (GNNs) do, which hurts where linked pages differ in class. Others weight propagation by an LLM-estimated homophily that costs extra calls and drifts across LLMs. We find that the sign with which links should enter a prediction, which we call structural polarity, is readable without true labels. It is the excess agreement of LLM labels and text-prototype predictions along links. We thus propose ZeroPolar, which gates one signed propagation step by this statistic. translated_title: 当链接产生误导时：面向网页零样本分类的无标签结构极性
translated_abstract: 数字图书馆、在线商店和大学网站等网络平台必须在有人进行标注之前对新页面进行分类。大语言模型（LLM）可以根据文本为每个页面打标签，但这些标签是含噪声的，且只有在被链接页面属于同一类别时，链接才能纠正这些标签。现有的零样本方法要么忽略链接，要么像标签传播和图神经网络（GNN）那样将页面拉向其邻居，这在链接页面类别不同的情况下反而有害。另一些方法则用LLM估计的同质性来为传播加权，这需要额外的调用开销，并且在不同LLM之间会产生漂移。我们发现，链接应进入预测的符号——我们称之为结构极性——在没有任何真实标签的情况下是可以读取的。它是LLM标签与文本原型预测沿链接的过度一致性。因此，我们提出了ZeroPolar，它利用这一统计量来门控单个带符号的传播步骤。免训练的ZeroPolar将原型分数与任意数量的LLM标签集相混合……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出ZeroPolar方法，利用无需真实标签即可读取的“结构极性”统计量（即LLM标签与文本原型预测沿链接的过度一致性）来门控带符号的传播步骤，实现免训练、且能同时适应同质与异质链接结构的网页零样本分类。
en_tdlr: ZeroPolar gates a single signed propagation step with a label-free "structural polarity" statistic — the excess agreement of LLM labels and text-prototype predictions along links — enabling training-free zero-shot web page classification that is robust to both homophilous and heterophilous links.
